material_definitions: The Li+ superionic argyrodites Li6PS5-xSexBr (0 <= x <= 1) were synthesized to study the influence of increasing the anion polarizability and replacing the free S2- site with Se2- on structure and transport properties.
The synthesis successfully yielded solid solutions within this compositional series.
All compounds exhibit minor impurity phase fractions of LiBr and Li3OBr (<5 wt %).
Ionic transport measurements were performed using temperature-dependent electrochemical impedance spectroscopy.

Se2- substitution was performed within Li6PS5-xSexBr (0 ≤ x ≤ 1) to study the effect of changing lattice polarizability and the influence of Br-/Ch2- exchange on the structure and lithium transport properties.
Increasing Se2- content resulted in increased lattice parameters and occupancy of the 16e Wyckoff position by Se2-, corresponding to the formation of PS3Se3- polyhedra.
A drastic decrease in Br-/Ch2- site disorder was observed.
Structural changes led to a rearrangement of Li+ from the 24g to the 48h site and a widening of the diffusion pathways.
The Li6PS5-xSexBr (x=0, 0.5, 1.0) series represents argyrodite-type solid solutions where sulfur is partially replaced by selenium.
Li6PS5Br corresponds to the composition with x=0.
The samples were characterized using temperature-dependent impedance spectroscopy.
Measurements show the ionic conductivity behavior across different stoichiometry and temperatures.
measurements.source_caption: **Figure 5.** (a) Representative Arrhenius plots of the conductivity values for  $\text{Li}_6\text{PS}_{5-x}\text{Se}_x\text{Br}$  (x=0,0.5,1.0) obtained from temperature-dependent impedance spectroscopy. (b) Nyquist plot of  $\text{Li}_6\text{PS}_{4.5}\text{Se}_{0.5}\text{Br}$  at 233 K, showing the impedance response and the fit with the provided equivalent circuit. The red semicircle corresponds to the bulk contribution, and the blue semicircle corresponds to the grain-boundary contribution. The apex frequency corresponds to  $1.5 \times 10^6$  Hz (red data point).

material_definitions: The material series studied is the argyrodite solid solution Li6PS(5-x)SexBr.
Substitution of sulfur with selenium is investigated for x values between 0.0 and 1.0.
The room-temperature ionic conductivity and activation energy were measured for these compositions.
The plot shows how Se content affects the lithium-ion transport properties.
measurements.source_caption: Figure 6. (a) Room-temperature conductivity and (b) activation energy  $E_A$  and Arrhenius prefactor  $\sigma_0$  for  $\text{Li}_6\text{PS}_{5-x}\text{Se}_x\text{Br}$  as a function of the Se content. Errors not shown are smaller than the symbol.
